an10.70:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an10.70:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannisinnā sannipatitā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti. seyyathīdaṃ:
an10.70:1.3: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ …pe… itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vāti.
an10.70:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu attanā ca appiccho hoti, appicchakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti.
an10.70:2.4: “appiccho bhikkhu appicchakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:3.1: attanā ca santuṭṭho hoti. santuṭṭhīkathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
an10.70:3.2: “santuṭṭho hoti, bhikkhu santuṭṭhīkathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti. pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:4.1: attanā ca pavivitto hoti, pavivekakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti.
an10.70:4.2: “pavivitto bhikkhu pavivekakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:5.1: attanā ca asaṃsaṭṭho hoti, asaṃsaṭṭhakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti,
an10.70:5.2: asaṃsaṭṭho bhikkhu asaṃsaṭṭhakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:6.1: attanā ca āraddhaviriyo hoti, viriyārambhakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti.
an10.70:6.2: “āraddhaviriyo bhikkhu viriyārambhakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:7.1: attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti, sīlasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti.
an10.70:7.2: “sīlasampanno bhikkhu sīlasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:8.1: attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti, samādhi sampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti.
an10.70:8.2: “samādhisampanno bhikkhu samādhisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ
an10.70:9.1: attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, paññāsampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti.
an10.70:9.2: “paññāsampanno bhikkhu paññāsampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:10.1: attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti, vimuttisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti.
an10.70:10.2: “vimuttisampanno bhikkhu vimuttisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:11.1: attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti, vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti.
an10.70:11.2: ‘vimuttiñāṇadassana’sampanno bhikkhu vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā”ti pāsaṃsametaṃ ṭhanāṃ.
an10.70:12.1: imāni kho bhikkhave dasa pāsaṃsāni ṭhānānīti.
